title: R34 Asthma Depression
official: Integrated Intervention for Depression and Asthma Self-management in Older Adults
summary: Depressive disorders are highly prevalent among older adults with asthma and are associated with poor asthma outcomes. The overall objective of this study is to integrate an asthma self-management support program that the research team previously developed with cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) for adherence and depression for older adults with uncontrolled asthma and a comorbid depressive disorder. The research team will conduct a pilot randomized controlled trial to assess the feasibility and preliminary impact of the intervention on asthma and depression outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English and Spanish speaking adults
* Ages greater than or equal to 60 years
* Have physician diagnosis of asthma for a year or more
* Prescribed at least one asthma controller medication
* Current diagnosis of major depressive disorder (MDD) or persistent depressive disorder (PDD)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of COPD or other chronic respiratory illness
* History of smoking for greater than or equal to 15 years or packs throughout lifetime
* Use of CBT in the past 12 months
* Initiation or recent dose change of SSRI/SNRI within past 6 weeks
